decisions.statement: An addon under `temper/addons` is found by reading that folder.
An addon elsewhere is found by asking the index for every `eso-addon` page.
A folder with no addon manifest of either spelling is no addon.
Whether a folder is a package says nothing about whether that folder is an addon.
An addon stating no name is named for the folder with that addon.
An addon is reached by canonical name or by the name of its own folder.
An addon outside `temper/addons` is reached by its parent folder's name too.
A name matching no addon answers as a folder under `temper/addons`.

definition: every addon the repository has, each with the folder that addon sits in
